metadata.title: Nido
metadata.description: Household finance, shared. From one person to the whole home.

marketing.headline: All your household money, in one nest
marketing.subhead: Shared expenses, fair splits, and clear accounts for couples, flatmates, or solo budgeting. Your data, your database.

problem.title: The spreadsheet is not enough
problem.subtitle: When money is shared, you need one place everyone trusts.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheets break down
spreadsheet.body: Broken formulas, conflicting copies, and no one knows the real total.

whoPaid.title: Who paid for what?
whoPaid.body: Arguments start when splits are unclear or impossible to verify.

subscription.title: Forgotten subscriptions
subscription.body: Small recurring charges that pile up because nobody reviews them.

splits.title: Exact splits
splits.body: Five split modes. Cents always add up — the database enforces it.

ledger.title: Instant ledger
ledger.body: Every expense, income, and transfer in a fast, filterable shared list.

budgets.title: Budgets with alerts
budgets.body: Category limits and warnings before you overspend, in your home currency.

balances.title: Balances between people
balances.body: Who owes whom, simplified. No informal running tabs.

modes.title: One app, three ways to live
modes.subtitle: The same core adapts to your household.

solo.label: Solo
solo.title: Personal finance
solo.body: Accounts, categories, and goals without split complexity.

couple.label: Couple
couple.title: Two people, one nest
couple.body: Shared and personal spending with fair splits by default.

flatshare.label: Flatshare
flatshare.title: Several roommates
flatshare.body: Participants, weights, and balances so no one keeps score by hand.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.body: Self-host on Supabase, no trackers or ads. Open source so you can verify.

openSource.title: Open and auditable
openSource.body: Next.js, Supabase, and strict TypeScript. Clone it, deploy it, make it yours.
openSource.snippet:
git clone github.com/EdvinCodes/nido
cd nido && pnpm install
pnpm db:start && pnpm db:reset
pnpm dev

finalCta.title: Get started in minutes
finalCta.body: Create your space, invite your household, and log the first expense.

footer.tagline: Shared household finance with numbers you can trust.

shell.emptyBody: Open the ledger to record your first expense, or invite your household and set up categories.
